🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 28, 2026

Moon and Uranus hold a conjunction in Gemini. Two air signs looking at each other: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Gemini, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Cardinal fire: beginning costs almost nothing. Saturn let go of it a week ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Scorpio, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Scorpio: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon occupies your sign: what you own is at hand, not in theory. Mutable air: the alternatives turn out identical. The sextile of three weeks ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Gemini untitled. Sun in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. Moon in Gemini opens a gap you have to step into. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. Sun left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Gemini, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable earth: keeping options is the expense. Mercury turned back a week ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you and holds Libra by right, not by favour. Moon trines you from Gemini, and what you hold finds words unforced. Air moves first here, and first is enough. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you from Leo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. With Sun in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Fixed water: what is kept and who keeps it merge. Nothing about it is a week old.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Gemini, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Fire adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. It has stood three weeks; by now the cost is known.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. The trine to Mars that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Gemini trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. Seven days ago none of this was in place.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon squares you from Gemini, and the cost objects. Water bends, and each bend is invoiced. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.
